title: Git before 2.56.1 and its backports: code execution on a recursive clone (CVE-2026-111760) and five more
summary: Git's maintainers released fixes for six vulnerabilities on 10 November 2026 (CVE-2026-111760, CVE-2026-113408, CVE-2026-114466, CVE-2026-114467, CVE-2026-114469 and CVE-2026-105437). GitHub's post says the fixes are in Git 2.56.1, with backports to 2.55.1, 2.54.1, 2.53.1, 2.52.1, 2.51.3 and 2.50.2. The most serious, CVE-2026-111760, is remote code execution when a malicious repository is cloned recursively (git's release notes: "Recursive clones are susceptible to Remote Code Execution"). CISA's catalog (version 2026.11.10) lists none of them. Wardlatch reads Homebrew's git from the keg its opt link names, Apple's git (Command Line Tools and Xcode) from the version string in the program file's bytes, and Debian's and Ubuntu's from dpkg's record; it never runs git for this. Apple and the distributions backport fixes without changing the upstream number, so their builds below it are REVIEW, not EXPOSED.

files.label: Apple, Command Line Tools
files.reviewBelow: this is Apple's build of git (it says "Apple Git"), and Apple backports fixes without changing that number. As of 13 Nov 2026 Apple has not said that a git it ships carries these fixes (Xcode 27.2's notes of 29 Oct name none), so this can't be judged either way

files.label: Apple, Xcode
files.reviewBelow: this is Apple's build of git (it says "Apple Git"), and Apple backports fixes without changing that number. As of 13 Nov 2026 Apple has not said that a git it ships carries these fixes (Xcode 27.2's notes of 29 Oct name none), so this can't be judged either way

files.label: Debian or Ubuntu package
files.reviewBelow: Debian and Ubuntu backport security fixes into their packages without changing the upstream number: check your distribution's security tracker for CVE-2026-111760 to see whether this package version has the fix

versionFiles.fix: Update git to 2.56.1 or later, or to its line's backport (2.55.1, 2.54.1, 2.53.1, 2.52.1, 2.51.3 or 2.50.2): with Homebrew, brew upgrade git. Until then, don't clone untrusted repositories with --recurse-submodules.
versionFiles.lookedIn: Homebrew's opt/git link, Apple's git in the Command Line Tools and Xcode, and dpkg's record of git

reviewFix: Until Apple (or your distribution) ships a git it says has these fixes, don't clone untrusted repositories with --recurse-submodules, or use Homebrew's git (brew install git, 2.56.1 or later) for them.
safeText: no git found in the places this check reads
notCovered: Homebrew kegs of git that are not the linked one; git installed by the git-scm.com installer, MacPorts, conda, or built from source; git bundled inside other apps (GitHub Desktop, IDEs); /usr/bin/git, which on a Mac only hands over to the Command Line Tools' or Xcode's git; Windows.
